record.title: Validate the exact two-store command pair
record.intent: Extend the tested write ledger by the second directly observed stock store.
requirements: Keep the existing two synthetic reads and group-wide continuous observation.
Accept only two ordered main-thread 32-bit stores at offset 0x3000 with values 0x05630000 then 0x01630000, bound to exact PC and opcode.
Complete each by PC-only advancement and observer-side ledger recording; keep the mapping inaccessible and supply no device side effect.
Positive private arms stop at a following main-thread or worker access without completion.
Negative private arms reject changed second value or offset after only one completed store.
Re-run existing controls with the rebuilt executable and verify all thread/event/state/cleanup evidence.
acceptance: Independent verification establishes ordered write counts, exact register preservation, negative guards and terminal attribution.
Preserve enforcement and system_server; commit and push controls before stock execution.
